description.blurb: Angrboda (formerly S/2004 S22 and Saturn LV) is a natural satellite of Saturn discovered in 2004 and announced in 2019.
description.more: In mythology, Angrboda is a Norse giantess, consort of Loki, and the mother of monsters. Angrboda is about 3 kilometres in diameter, and orbits Saturn in 1107.13 days, at an inclination of 177° to the ecliptic.​
